baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph inside an empty analog planetarium during a late-night calibration. An unmistakably adult woman stands to the left of a waist-high opto-mechanical star projector. Use the supplied portrait only to guide her visible adult facial appearance and hair: a chin-length dark bob with wispy bangs, dark eyes, and softly rounded facial features. Show her as a new subject in this scene, with natural skin texture and the same calm, attentive expression rather than a copied room or outfit. Her right thumb and forefinger turn the knurled focusing collar on the projector's near lens module; the right forearm leads visibly from her shoulder to that collar. Her left palm braces the fixed metal housing immediately beneath the lens. Both hands and the clear lens aperture remain visible. She is standing within comfortable reach of the machine, looking from the lens toward a small bright calibration star on the curved dome above. A narrow cone of projector light rises from the aperture to the dome, where pinpoint stars follow the ceiling's curvature. Frame her face, hands, the metal projector, and a broad arc of dome in one three-quarter environmental portrait. A low amber task lamp grazes brushed metal and catches a contained specular glint on the convex lens glass; cool projected light brushes one cheek and the projector's edges. The projector housing casts a coherent shadow on the floor. Fine dust becomes visible only inside the light cone. Retain realistic depth, tactile metal wear, subtle skin detail, and a quiet, precise observational mood.
